content: expo-iap 5.6.2: Expo Module (NOT Nitro), npx expo install expo-iap, StoreKit 2 via openiap-apple and Google Play Billing 8.x via openiap-google, OpenIAP spec conformant, same hyodotdev/openiap monorepo as react-native-iap. Expo official in-app-purchases guide mentions only RevenueCat and expo-iap; react-native-iap no longer appears. expo-iap avoids the nitro version-pin conflict with MMKV.
